title: YouTube raises Premium prices in the US, with individual plans up $2 to $15.99 per month, family plan up $4 to $26.99, and Premium Lite up $1 to $8.99 (Dominic Preston/The Verge)
summary: Dominic Preston / The Verge: YouTube raises Premium prices in the US, with individual plans up $2 to $15.99 per month, family plan up $4 to $26.99, and Premium Lite up $1 to $8.99 — The standard plan is going up by $2 a month in the US. … YouTube Premium is getting more expensive in the US, with prices rising by $2 …
